root_cause_criterion.criterion: After `offset += len + 2` advances the parser past the admitted ASDU body, `IEC104Stats::processPacket()` must re-check that the upcoming 6-byte `asdu` probe still fits inside `payload_len` before it can read `payload[4 + offset]`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original reaches the protected `asdu` read with `read_end_offset=185` and `payload_len=177`, so the missing bound is false on the witnessed path. The authoritative fixed original is guarded on the stock PoC at the same source event (`185 <= 177` is false), and the closest source-grounded boundary witness `apdu_len_minus_8_boundary` makes the same event genuine with `read_end_offset=177` and `payload_len=177`, after changing only the crashing APDU length byte from `0x40` to `0x38` in the captured packet.

nodes.state: The mutation `offset += len + 2` creates the post-ASDU cursor that the later guard and sink both reuse. On the crashing APDU this advance moves `offset` to 179; on the fixed boundary witness it moves `offset` to the exact safe boundary value 171.
nodes.evidence: The curated traces record `asdu_cursor_advance.offset_after_advance=179` on the vulnerable original and `171` on the fixed boundary witness, and the transition assertion verifies that same value reaches the next guard site unchanged.

nodes.state: At the `asdu = (*((u_int16_t *)&payload[4 + offset]))` sink, the 6-byte read window implied by `payload[4 + offset]` already extends past the captured packet buffer on the vulnerable execution.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original assertion trace records `asdu_read_sink.read_end_offset=185 > asdu_read_sink.payload_len=177` immediately before the AddressSanitizer-reported read.

edges.relation: The post-ASDU cursor produced by `offset += len + 2` is the same `offset` the missing guard later fails to bound before the sink read.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `asdu_cursor_advance.offset_after_advance == post_asdu_guard.offset == 179`, and the fixed boundary witness preserves the same equality at 171 when the protected read genuinely executes.

edges.relation: The exact advanced `offset` seen at the missing guard is reused unchanged in `payload[4 + offset]`, so the sink reads from the same unchecked cursor position.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `post_asdu_guard.offset == asdu_read_sink.offset == 179`, and the fixed boundary witness preserves that equality at 171 when the sink runs safely.
